seriesTitle: The Sex Lives of College Girls

episodes.title: Welcome to Essex
episodes.summary: As they start settling into college life, first-year suite mates Kimberly, Bela, Leighton, and Whitney navigate relationships, extracurriculars, and culture shock. Later, the girls hit an exclusive party to blow off some steam.

episodes.title: Naked Party
episodes.summary: The first week of class finds Kimberly feeling out of her league, while Leighton thrives academically… but not so much otherwise. Whitney confronts soccer drama, and – looking to get properly wild – Bela and Kimberly go to a naked party.

episodes.title: Le Tuteur
episodes.summary: While Kimberly connects with Nico during a tutoring session, Leighton begrudgingly starts volunteering at the women's center, Bela explores the local dating app pool, and Whitney seeks to take things with Dalton to the next level.

episodes.title: Kappa
episodes.summary: After mingling with an exclusive sorority, Leighton gets roped into a date with a boy, while Whitney confides in a teammate about her relationship with Dalton. With Kimberly in tow, Bela speaks her mind at a high-profile Catullan event.

episodes.title: That Comment Tho
episodes.summary: While a cryptic message from Nico sends Kimberly reeling, Leighton invites the women's center to her brother's frat party. Bela has an uncomfortable experience with a Catullan editor, and Whitney navigates the fallout of investigative work.

episodes.title: Parents Weekend
episodes.summary: After reuniting with their families for the first time since move-in day, the girls struggle through an uncomfortable dinner, where parents clash, egos are bruised, and secrets are revealed.

episodes.title: I Think I'm a Sex Addict
episodes.summary: While Bela anxiously awaits the Catullan's final decision, Kimberly gets hooked on casual sex with Nico, Whitney explores her connection with Canaan, and Leighton takes the next step with Alicia.

episodes.title: The Surprise Party
episodes.summary: At Leighton's surprise party for Nico, an unexpected guest sends Kimberly reeling. Bela worries she silenced a fellow Catullan writer, and a rumor threatens to upend Whitney's world.

episodes.title: Cheating
episodes.summary: A heartbroken Kimberly considers cheating on an exam. Leighton's fear of coming out upends her weekend getaway with Alicia. Bela navigates the fallout of exposing assault. Whitney confronts the truth about Dalton.

episodes.title: The Truth
episodes.summary: While Kimberly faces possible expulsion after her honor code violation, Bela takes a stand against the Catullan's culture, Whitney levels with her mom, and Leighton speaks her truth.

episodes.title: Winter is Coming
episodes.summary: While grappling with their new status as campus narcs, Bela starts an all-female comedy mag, Whitney embarks on the soccer off-season, and Kimberly explores ways to make up for her lost scholarship – with unexpected help from Leighton.

episodes.title: Frat Problems
episodes.summary: Bela and Leighton organize a sexy fundraiser to get back on Theta's good side – and into frat parties again. Kimberly tries to find another co-signer for her loan, while Whitney feels threatened by Canaan's new coworker.

episodes.title: The Short King
episodes.summary: While Leighton enjoys the perks of being out, Bela focuses on a short king. Whitney attempts to expand her horizons with a difficult class, and Kimberly considers a new fix for her money problems.

episodes.title: Will You Be My Girlfriend?
episodes.summary: Bela scrambles to expand The Foxy's reach ahead of its release. Jackson invites Kimberly to a study session. Canaan asks Whitney to be his girlfriend… but she already thought they were dating. Leighton gets called out.

episodes.title: Taking Shots
episodes.summary: Leighton helps Kimberly administer her hormone injections. Whitney considers how to handle being repeatedly mistaken for the only other Black girl in class. Bela clashes with her Catullan replacement.

episodes.title: Doppelbanger
episodes.summary: Bela seizes an opportunity when a late-night comic visits campus. Kimberly attempts to prove she hasn't been "med-zoned" by Jackson. Whitney fights to contribute to a group assignment. Leighton pursues a junior... who reminds her of herself.

episodes.title: The Essex College Food Workers Strike
episodes.summary: Leighton grapples with "dating up" for the first time. Kimberly appeals to an unlikely source for help with the food workers' strike. Whitney sets out to crush her final lab. Bela's faces blowback from a misstep.

episodes.title: Pre-Frosh Weekend
episodes.summary: For Pre-Frosh Weekend, Bela hosts her nerdy childhood friend Priya, who's had a surprise glow-up. Leighton prepares to come out to her dad. Kimberly seeks commonalities with Jackson, while Whitney finds chemistry with her lab partner.

episodes.title: Sex & Basketball
episodes.summary: Whitney and Andrew attempt to bring their chemistry into the real world. Bela over-curates The Foxy's big spotlight. Kimberly accompanies Canaan to the Econ department's awards banquet. Leighton visits the women's center – and Alicia.

episodes.title: The Rooming Lottery
episodes.summary: When Leighton is elected Kappa's campus social chair, the roommates must figure out what sophomore year will look like.

episodes.title: Welcome Back to Essex
episodes.summary: As their sophomore year begins, Kimberly is determined to mend her friendship with Whitney. Meanwhile, Bela attempts to change her ways with a new opportunity, and Alicia drops a bomb on Leighton.

episodes.title: Lila by Lila
episodes.summary: Kimberly tries to upgrade their dorm, Whitney has a specific gripe with a hot classmate, Bela struggles as a FAF, and Leighton thinks on her future.

episodes.title: Four to a Suite
episodes.summary: The girls meet their new roommate, Kacey. Bela weighs whether a nice guy is hot or not, Kimberly visits her first sex shop, and Whitney's increasingly busy schedule leads to some complications with a professor.

episodes.title: Franklin the Fox
episodes.summary: Bela hooks up with the mascot, Kacey puts herself out there, Whitney struggles to find balance in her life, and Kimberly goes to her first rave.

episodes.title: Parents Weekend 2
episodes.summary: It's Parents Weekend at Essex once again! The girls do everything they can to keep their visiting families out of their dating lives, all while conducting an important science experiment for Bela and learning more about their new roommate Kacey.

episodes.title: Halloween & Oat Milk
episodes.summary: It's Halloween on Essex campus! Before they can party, Kimberly tries to impress her professor, Whitney has a weird workout at the gym, Bela gets creative to keep Taylor from hanging around too much, and Lila hunts down a hottie.

episodes.title: The Rodeo
episodes.summary: The campus magazine releases their annual list of the hottest students on campus. Bela attempts to break a dry spell, Kimberly enjoys a rare free day to herself, and Whitney's science project gets messy as the girls join Taylor at The Queer Rodeo.

episodes.title: The Good Partner Test
episodes.summary: As things become more serious with Cooper, Kacey decides to secretly put him through The Good Partner Test. Intrigued, Bela, Whitney and Kimberly decide to test the people they're dating, too.

episodes.title: Pics
episodes.summary: As Kacey preps for a special date, Kimberly takes her first nude. Bela hits a roadblock with Arvind, and Whitney prioritizes her needs.

episodes.title: Essex Strong
episodes.summary: With a protest looming on campus, the girls find themselves standing up for themselves, for what they need, and for each other.
